visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair, wearing a white off-shoulder top, stands in a modern kitchen with grey cabinetry and a stainless steel refrigerator. She gestures excitedly with both hands toward the camera, her facial expression showing wide eyes and a smile. CGI gold coin graphics fly across the screen. She then reaches toward a built-in oven, opening it to reveal an orange gift box. (2) The woman holds the orange box titled "Hui Love It" towards the camera. She takes out two individually wrapped pastries from the box. The scene cuts to a high-angle close-up of two pastries cut in half on a wooden board, showcasing a golden egg yolk and a purple taro filling. (3) The woman is seen biting into a golden pastry, closing her eyes and nodding with a thumbs-up gesture. Close-up shots highlight the layered texture of the red bean and egg yolk interior. The background shows kitchen utensils and a dark-colored countertop. (4) She holds up a purple taro pastry close to the camera. A macro shot shows the liquid egg yolk center surrounded by a mochi layer and purple taro paste. She points at the cross-section with her index finger, emphasizing the textures. (5) The woman holds two pastries, one in each hand, smiling at the camera. The scene cuts to an orange gift bag with black lettering and a brochure on a white marble table. She finishes by holding the orange box and pointing downwards toward the bottom of the frame.
